ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَأَصْحَابِهِ وَأَتْبَاعِهِ وَ عَلَى سَائِرِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤمِنَاتِ ، الْأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتِ ، وَتَابِعْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ بِالْخَيْرَاتِ وَالْبَرَكَاتِ ، إِنَّكَ قَرِيْبٌ مُجِيْبُ الدَّعَوَاتِ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa aṣḥābihī wa atbā`ihī wa `ala sā’iri ‘l-mu’minīna wa ‘l-mu’mināti ‘l-aḥyā’i minhum wa ‘l-amwāti, Wa tābi` baynanā wa baynahum bi ‘l-khayrāti wa ‘l-barakāti, Innaka qarībun mujību ‘d-da`awāti, Yā Rabba ‘l-Ālamīn.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family, Companions and Followers and the rest of the believing men and women, the living of them and the dead, and follow up with goodness and blessings between us and them, surely You are Near and Responsive to Supplicants, O Lord of the Worlds!
